notes.title: The Lemonade coming to Steam
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
just a quick announcement.
I have been working on a new puzzle game called "The Lemonade" and, hopefully, it will be out soon.
In it, you play as a goblin traversing underground caverns to find as many lemons as possible for the purpose of making lemonade. It's a small open-world sokoban game that I hope will entice you.
Most of the riddles are optional and you have some degree of freedom in the order you tackle the various puzzles, as well as infinite undos.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2502040/The_Lemonade/]The Steam page for it is up at this link![/url]

If interested, please consider wishlisting it and following me on [url=https://twitter.com/maker_of_syzygy]twitter[/url] for further updates.

Thanks,
Riccardo

notes.title: Syzygy becomes Free
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
despite my best efforts in the year that has passed since release, Syzygy has remained an extremely obscure game with few and sparse sales only at launch and during discounts.
I have failed completely at promotion, for which I certainly have not a natural talent but a strong aversion.
Nevertheless, I worked hard on Syzygy for many years because I wanted to create something that could genuinely surprise and lift the spirit of those who play it, but now seeing that less than a hundred people were willing to engage in the experience is most painful.
I want to believe that Syzygy is worth playing and that the only obstacle that separates it from people who might enjoy it is an issue of discoverability.

Therefore, I am planning to make the game freely available to everyone in a few weeks, hoping that this will be a new opportunity for Syzygy to flourish.

Quite some time has passed since the last copy sold but, if you bought the game and you feel that I am in any way doing you wrong with my decision, please request a refund. I understand.
I still want to thank anyone who decided to purchase the game in the past, left a review or reached out to share some thoughts on the game with me: your support is invaluable.
I won't give up making video games and, hopefully, I will be able to announce a new game soon enough. In the meantime, thanks for reading these few words.

Riccardo
